summary.goal: Implement SQLite persistence for Sessions, following the same patterns as planner-core storage.

acceptance_criteria.description: Sessions table stores: id, status, initiative_id, source (JSONB), transcript (JSONB), understanding (JSONB), active_specialists (JSONB), planner_sends (JSONB), timestamps
IdeationStorage interface defines CRUD operations for sessions
SQLiteIdeationStorage implements the interface using better-sqlite3
Database initialization creates tables if not exists
Transcript can be appended without replacing entire session
Understanding can be updated per-specialist (freeform key) without overwriting others
active_specialists can be appended/updated for lazy spawning tracking
planner_sends can be appended with full payload snapshot
Sessions can be queried by status and initiative_id

steps.title: Define IdeationStorage interface
steps.description: Create TypeScript interface for storage operations

acceptance_criteria.description: createSession(source, initiative_id?) -> Session
getSession(id) -> Session | null
listSessions(filter?: { status?, initiative_id? }) -> Session[]
updateSessionStatus(id, status) -> Session
appendTranscript(id, message: TranscriptMessage) -> Session
updateUnderstanding(id, specialistName: string, observations: Record<string, unknown>) -> Session
addActiveSpecialist(id, specialist: ActiveSpecialist) -> Session
removeActiveSpecialist(id, specialistName: string) -> Session
appendPlannerSend(id, send: PlannerSend) -> Session

steps.title: Create SQLite schema and initialization
steps.description: Define CREATE TABLE statements and init function

acceptance_criteria.description: Sessions table: id TEXT PK, status TEXT, initiative_id TEXT, source TEXT (JSON), transcript TEXT (JSON), understanding TEXT (JSON), active_specialists TEXT (JSON), planner_sends TEXT (JSON), created_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT
Index on status, initiative_id for filtering
initDatabase(db) function creates tables if not exist
createSession generates UUID, initializes empty transcript/understanding/active_specialists, sets status='active'
getSession returns null if not found
listSessions accepts optional status and initiative_id filters, returns sorted by updated_at DESC
updateSessionStatus updates status and updated_at timestamp

steps.title: Implement transcript append operation
steps.description: Implement appendTranscript that appends without full replacement

Updates updated_at timestamp
Returns updated Session

steps.title: Implement understanding update operation

acceptance_criteria.description: Uses SQLite JSON functions to set specific specialist key in understanding object
